title: Event
description: One entry in the METIS event log — the tamper-evident semantic record the safety story rests on. This is not Restate's execution journal and must never be merged with it (ADR-016): that journal is disposable execution mechanics, this is the audit trail.

id.description: Also the idempotency key — appending the same id twice is one event (ADR-007).

type.description: SCREAMING_SNAKE. Left open rather than enumerated because new event types arrive with every subsystem, but the shape is pinned so the log stays greppable.

correlationId.description: Ties every event produced by one request or run together. ADR-009 requires errors to carry the same correlationId as the work that failed; without a field for it that requirement could not be met.
